text_block_list.text: "Having achieved a brilliant result in the Keisei Hai, Eishin Flash was scheduled to hold a brief Q&A session after the race."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: “—First of all, thank you for your hard work. May we ask for your impressions of the race?”

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was a very productive session for our next race.
There are certainly areas to work on, but I have no doubts.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I see. If I may ask, what is your definite target for your next race...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, it's the Satsuki Sho. That's where it all begins—
my challenge for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's what I thought would happen.
Still... this year's rivals are pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: "She ran so well today too, and I really want to root for her, but..."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I'm not... the lead...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash-san.
There are some seriously talented Umamusume aiming for the Triple Crown this year. Are you aware?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Do we have any chance of winning as things stand?
I know it's going to be a difficult path, but...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have no chance of winning.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I am well aware that this is a path filled with hardship.
That is why I have prepared for it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, there are no chances of victory.
I simply do what must be done, and beyond that—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —The results will follow. That is all.

Eishin Flash stated with absolute confidence.
Seeing her speak so matter-of-factly, none of the reporters asked similar questions anymore.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"We ended up finishing 15 minutes
earlier than planned, didn't we...?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps I should have acted
a bit more warmly.
choice_data_list: You were so confident and cool out there!
You were so confident and cool out there!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...If that's the case, I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That press conference earlier made it crystal clear.
While her ability is somewhat acknowledged, the general consensus is that she falls short of challenging for the Triple Crown.
choice_data_list: Let's change how they see you at the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I feel the same way.
The next race is finally our debut match, the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"The same course and the same distance as today's race.
I've got the feel for it down perfectly."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Kein Problem, Trainer.
Let us proceed as planned."
